d: Long, straight rust-orange hair with blunt bangs and two long side-locks frames a youthful, child-like face with an annoyed expression and orange-gold eyes behind rectangular glasses. The petite build is dressed in a dark navy blue sailor-style outfit consisting of a long-sleeved top with a white collar and a matching pleated mini-skirt. Signature details include a gold circular button on the collar and heavy grey metallic naval artillery equipment attached to the back and hip.
